en.topic_title: China ruling party says ‘eliminated dangers’ after expelling record 33 top officials
en.topic_summary:
China has eradicated “serious hidden dangers” in its Communist Party and military under President Xi Jinping’s leadership, a senior official said on Friday, a day after authorities confirmed the expulsion of a record 33 figures.
